sky_grade._doc: [0.7.59] re-graded once the cloud layers fade toward the horizon and move at the original's speed (the dark layers no longer cover the low sky): 80 s / 40 s means at the same view, orig / ours 0.82 at 7 deg, 0.80 at 9-13, 0.87 at 16, 0.94 at 22 -> k x those (40 / 90 deg x the 22 deg ratio); 0-4 deg kept (tree tops in the band). Not re-measured after this step (decodeaudit/ea stills_cloud59b = before). Earlier: [0.7.58, user via coordinator 2026-11-23: our night sky darker and flatter than the original] measured against the emulator at the player start (ref_xemu sky/clouds_1123/level2, 80 s mean, pitch 0) vs ours at the same spot, yaw and pitch (decodeaudit/ea/stills_sky0 before, stills_sky2 after: 16-22 deg within 1 %, 5-13 deg -5..-8 % where our taller tree tops fall in the measured band; 40 / 90 deg extrapolated [PROV]): the sky box is multiplied by k at each elevation (degrees, linear between) and by rgb; the horizon band (0-4 deg, already equal) and everything below the horizon are untouched; the world is not changed. EA_SKY_GRADE=0 = off

sky_disc._doc: level stream texture names of the original sky half-cube and moon; quad = x, y0, y1, z0, z1 in metres from the eye; gain = on-screen brightness against the raw texture (0.7 to 0.8 measured)

1_11._interior_gain_doc: 0.7.51 church world light (user 2026-11-22 'extremely dark inside'): ours measured median 15-19 vs the emulator's 21 at the same nave spot (sky matched 1:1 at the far-city vantage); x1.35 on the baked vertex light inside the church's irradiance volumes. FIDELITY C52

mist._doc: the creek mist (RUS1_Fog_02) as the engine's height mist hzm_mist (eafx.mist_key, tr_hzm_mist.c): user-approved 2026-11-13, the original's layout with its artifacts fixed; density per unit at the core, gain on the cards' start colour

dawn._enabled_doc: false until the dawn-eng renderer (alphaGen skyAlpha + window, hzm_mist_dawn, SHADER_MAX_VERTEXES 8192) is merged and shipped: an older renderer draws the dawn layers opaque at night and its 2048-vertex batch ERR_DROPs on the 8-stage dome. Flip to true in the release that ships the renderer (EA_DAWN=1 at conversion forces it on for tests).
dawn._doc: user request 2026-11-22 (FIDELITY C44): night to dawn on the mission clock (coop_mod/eadawn.scr). Computed sky layers (eadawn_sky.py, not disc data) blended over the night box by the dawn progress; sun_yaw = the sunrise bearing in map yaw degrees (sunrise on 28 Jan 1943 at 48.8 N is ~118 deg true, ESE; the map's north is not decoded, so it is set where the church defence sees it); mist = the low mist's morning r g b and density factor (worldspawn hzm_mist_dawn); cloud_* = the original's cloud layers again in morning light over that window. EA_NO_DAWN=1 at conversion leaves all of it out.

skyline_pull._min_dist_doc: min_dist (pushing the near cards back) was tried at 3800 on 2026-11-15: the widened far ends passed the far plane and the skyline broke into separate clumps; left off

glow_arc._hot_doc: yaw from the vantage eye of the five distant fire / glow packages (RUS1_DistantFire_01-03, DistantGlow_01-02)

skyline_pull._doc: the distant ruined-city skyline cards (EDrA, 6,000-11,000u out, past the 4,560u far plane) drawn 4,200u from the map centre, scaled about the eye, fog-free: from the vantage the original shows the skyline along the whole horizon (ref_xemu atmo far_*c, 2026-11-15)

fire_tune._doc: the village roof, straw-roof and fires' flame systems matched to the original (ref_xemu atmo roof_fires2 / corners_before from disc (-11, 53): tall bright open flames above the rooflines; 1:1 they were thin licks on the timbers). eafx._fire_tune; EA_NO_FIRETUNE=1 off

distant_fx_pull._doc: fidelity item (2026-11-13, user-approved 2026-11-13, brightness pending the emulator compare): the distant fire/glow packages sit 6,000-10,000u out, past the far plane, and are clipped; the original draws effects in a fog-off pass of their own. approved true draws each at dist from the nearest AI/player place, scaled to keep its size on screen (eafx._distant_pull); EA_DISTPULL=1 for a test conversion; gain lifts colour keeping the hue, alpha_gain lifts alpha, halo adds the glow system again wider and fainter (user: fires that illuminate heavily out through the distance); the systems draw fog-free (nofog, a stage keyword: at shader level gl2 rejected the shaders and they vanished, 2026-11-13; EA_FX_FOGGED=1 for the v1.10.80 fogged look); fog-free they show flame cores under their own lit smoke, so the lift is x2.0 / alpha x1.3 and the halo only 1.6x at 0.2 (the original's horizon fires are small bright flames, ref_xemu walk/ea/s8)

1_11._headroom_carve: engine-forced door clearances (flconvert 0.7.30, coordinator 2026-11-13): [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1] boxes where the collision is cut, the drawn geometry untouched. The barn by the hut point (2000, -2850): its east door arch stands 76u over the floor (-536.5), carved to 116u over the floor (94u standing box + the 18u the engine needs over it to step) so the men spawned inside can leave
